text:
Rhea Johnson: Quick heads-up: offer for candidate Marco Li (Senior Infra Eng). Hiring manager requesting provisional band uplift (M5->M6) + $9k sign-on, plus a 2-week preboarding stipend to cover temporary housing if start is moved earlier. Need routing and fastest ETA.
Priya Kapoor: Can you post manager justification and proposed start dates? Also curious why provisional not permanent.
Marco Li: I received a competing offer; am strong on Redwood but need clarity on comp and start timing. Can confirm acceptance if we lock details today.
Rhea Johnson: Manager justification uploaded: market comps, project ramp urgency, and 90-day review plan. Proposed start 2026-05-18 (default 06-01). Preboarding stipend = $2k for up to 14 days temporary housing.
Priya Kapoor: Routing checklist: band-exception form, sign-on approval, preboarding stipend approval (nonstandard), payroll/tax treatment for stipend, clawback language, Workday fields.
hr-ops-bot: Request 3769998888 received. Approvals required: Comp Committee, Legal Team, Payroll Ops. Deadline 24h due to candidate timeline.
Comp Committee: Flag: $9k sign-on is above soft cap. Need manager attestation and evidence. Also confirm provisional length (90 days?).
Rhea Johnson: Confirming 90-day provisional review. Added attestation and market data.
Comp Committee: Approved provisional M6 for 90 days and $9k sign-on contingent on Legal + Payroll sign-off.
Legal Team: Preboarding stipend needs to be treated as taxable income; drafting offer language and clawback for sign-on and stipend if departure within 6 months. Also requesting CFO sign-off on stipend policy exception.
Payroll Ops: Stipend can be processed as a one-time taxable payment. Need cost center and invoice code to schedule. If start before payroll lock, we can manual-pay the stipend separately.
Rhea Johnson: Manager provided cost_center=ENG-PLAT and invoice_code=PLAT-9901.
CFO Approval Bot: Auto-check: stipend exceptions > $1k require CFO approval. Escalating to @Evelyn Park.
Priya Kapoor: Evelyn, can you confirm the extra-stipend exception? Candidate timeline is tight (24h).
Evelyn Park (EVP People): Approved one-time $2k preboarding stipend given relocation hardship and strategic hire. CFO notified.
hr-ops-bot: Approvals update: Comp Committee=approved, Legal Team=approved, Payroll Ops=approved, EVP People=approved.
Priya Kapoor: Great. Rhea please send updated offer including provisional band M6 (90-day review), $9k sign-on, $2k preboarding stipend (taxable), clawback terms, start date 2026-05-18. Acceptance window 24h. CC payroll for Workday entries.
Rhea Johnson: Sending offer now. Marco, we'll follow up with exact Workday/payroll timelines if you accept.
Marco Li: Thanks everyone. Please send ASAP; I'll review and aim to sign within 24h.
Priya Kapoor: Noting action item for onboarding to prepare temporary housing checklist if stipend is claimed. Also tagging relocation ops.
Rhea Johnson: Closing thread pending candidate acceptance. Will re-open if any approvals change or candidate requests modifications.
